about: Hand-labelled gold set for Claude guest-name extraction (lib/guestNames.ts). Labelled by reading each title and its show notes. `expected` is the guest list a person would write (full names as the TITLE spells them, no honorifics, never the show host, [] for solo/AMA/Q&A/summary episodes); compared case-, accent- and order-insensitively. `unsure: true` marks labels a human should confirm. `notes` is the show-notes text the model is shown (HTML stripped, first 600 characters). `group` says why the episode was picked: rules-differ (legacy and strict title rules disagree), drive-credential-junk-or-multi, drive-ama-or-solo, fmf-title-forms, huberman-special, random-agree (seeded random sample where the rules agree).
